rows.label: LOOK 02
rows.text: Cropped jacket of stacked waistbands, wide trousers with seams out

rows.label: LOOK 03
rows.text: Legs cut into long panels, dark and light in turn, as a long skirt

rows.label: SHARED
rows.text: The old waistbands, side seams and yellow stitching kept

notes: LOOKs 02 and 03 share one idea: the parts that make jeans recognisable, moved somewhere new. The cropped jacket in LOOK 02 is built from the waistbands of many pairs stacked in rows, and the wide trousers turn the old side seams outwards as a detail. LOOK 03 cuts jeans legs into long tapering panels and alternates dark and light into a long skirt, keeping the original yellow topstitching on every panel.
